title: Death text printed over the round-end winner banner
body: Seen in the Survival report screenshot: 'Waiting for next round...' overlapped 'BLUE WINS' and the MVP line. The death lines now hide while the winner banner is visible. Gate stage R gained tools/respawn_test.gd (death screen must clear on the next life, timed and Survival).

title: Top bar dropped a team's score when it had nobody alive (Survival)
body: The score strip listed teams from living soldiers plus teams that already scored, so in Survival a wiped-out team with 0 points disappeared (screenshot showed only 'BLUE 0'). Team modes now always list BLUE and RED.

title: Objective arrow label overlapped its own arrow at the side edges
body: On the right edge the label 'FLAG 214m' ran under the arrow head (report screenshot). The label is now placed its own width back from the arrow, clamped on screen.

title: Survival: show who's still alive while you wait for the next round
body: The waiting screen only said 'Waiting for next round...'. It now shows the living count per team (or players left in FFA), updated live.

title: Explain the Realistic / Survival / Advance options in the menu
body: Survival was on without the player knowing why they couldn't respawn. The three boxes now have tooltips describing the rules.
